clips.title: THE LONELINESS
clips.veo_prompt: Close-up shot with slow push-in over 4 seconds. A single small Blue Neon Tetra fish, approximately 3cm long, with characteristic iridescent blue horizontal stripe from nose to adipose fin, red-orange lower half, translucent fins, large expressive black eyes. The fish hovers motionless in crystal-clear water, colors noticeably muted and dull, appearing small and isolated. Beautiful planted aquarium with green plants in soft bokeh background creates ironic contrast - perfect environment, lonely fish. Low-key cinematic lighting with cool blue undertones. The fish's muted colors suggest depression. Camera slowly pushes toward the fish's eye, building emotional tension. SFX: Deep melancholic underwater ambiance, single low piano note. Ambient noise: Eerie silence broken only by distant filter hum. palette: dominant loneliness blue #1E3A5F, cool teal undertones. lighting: low-key, color_temp 4500K, dramatic shadows. seed: 88721

clips.title: THE TRANSFORMATION
clips.veo_prompt: Dynamic medium shot with crane descending movement over 4 seconds. Water surface ripples as 5 new Blue Neon Tetras descend gracefully from above. The original lonely tetra, initially frozen, suddenly perks up - fins extend, colors visibly brighten in real-time from muted to vibrant. The fish swims eagerly toward the group. Lighting transforms rapidly from cool blue to warm golden as the fish join together. The school begins synchronized swimming. Colors reach peak vibrancy - iridescent blue stripes now brilliant, red-orange bodies glowing. Energy shifts from stillness to life. SFX: Ascending shimmer sounds, gentle splash, heartwarming orchestral swell, satisfying chord resolution. Ambient noise: Active water movement, bubbling life sounds. palette: transitioning #1E3A5F → #F5A623 golden warmth. lighting: cold→warm, color_temp 4500K→5600K. seed: 88721

clips.title: THE JOY + LOOP
clips.veo_prompt: Wide shot slowly pulling back over 2 seconds. The school of 6 Blue Neon Tetras weaves beautifully through aquarium plants in balletic synchronized movement. All fish display peak vibrancy - brilliant iridescent blue stripes catching light, red-orange bodies glowing warmly. The aquarium that seemed empty is now alive with movement and color. Final moment: camera continues pulling back, the scene begins to subtly desaturate and cool down, transitioning the viewer's eye back toward isolation feeling - creating seamless loop to Clip 1. SFX: Gentle resolution chord, subtle fade, return of melancholic undertone at very end for loop continuity. palette: peak warmth #F5A623 → subtle cooling at end for loop. lighting: warm golden → slight blue creep at final frames. seed: 88721
